_about: cc-P101: the Shard Console's Websites tab reads this file. One entry per site. When a site moves (P89 H3, the move to Haven), change it here, not in the console. No key, password or token ever goes in this file: Haven is reached with Chase's own SSH key (agent or ~/.ssh), and NPM's login stays in his password manager.

haven._ssh: From D:\UO\haven-migration\Deploy-Website.ps1 and the other Haven scripts there.

npm._npm: NPM's admin page listens only on Haven's own 127.0.0.1:81 (haven-proxy-fix.sh step 2, proxy-discovery.txt line 278), so it is reached through an SSH tunnel, as Haven-Website-Runbook.original.md step 3 says: ssh -N -L 8081:localhost:81 chase@192.168.1.61, then http://localhost:8081.

sites.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
sites._check: The admin page is only reachable through the tunnel, so the light checks NPM's proxy port on Haven instead: any answer means NPM is up.

sites.name: Print queue
sites._printqueue: cc-P109: the Sunflower opener print queue (Sunflower Custom Gifts, not the shard), LAN only. Its code is in C:\dev\sunflower\print-queue, outside both shard repos; the light reads down until the first print-queue deploy.

sites.name: Mega dashboard
sites._megadash: cc-P110: the one Homepage on Haven (Shattered Legacy, Sunflower, home lab), from docker\dashboard\haven. Home and tailnet only. Until its deploy, port 3000 on Haven is the stale Homepage, so the light can read up before the real one runs.

website.what: copies the website page, its images and the intro video from docker\website\html to Haven (scp, then chmod)

wiki-macros.what: rebuilds the wiki's Macros pages from the TazUO Legion scripts and pushes them to Haven

ops-pages.what: cc-P107: puts the ops pages' stack on Haven (docker/ops), makes its deploy key and token the first time and starts the repo pull; after the cutover it also restarts the page on the new code. Discovery and the plan first, then the typed word deploy

ops-cutover.what: cc-P107: stops the game PC's Play tests page, seeds Haven's data from testing, starts Haven's page and checks it file by file, then switches the console and the commit to Haven. Typed word: cut over

ops-rollback.what: cc-P107: takes Haven's data into testing, stops Haven's page and starts the game PC's again. Typed word: roll back

print-queue.what: cc-P109: puts the Sunflower print queue on Haven (C:\dev\sunflower\print-queue\haven\Deploy-PrintQueue.ps1), makes its own SSH key for the Sunflower site the first time (public half printed once, for Hostinger), and the first time moves its data from this PC. Discovery and the plan first, then the typed word deploy

print-queue-rollback.what: cc-P109: takes Haven's print queue data back to this PC, stops Haven's container and starts the game PC server again. Typed word: roll back

mega-dashboard.what: cc-P110: puts the one Homepage on Haven (docker\dashboard\haven) with its read-only Docker proxy, writes its env file the first time (the ops token copied on Haven), stops the stale Homepage there and then this PC's sl-dashboard (both stopped, not removed). Discovery (Haven's containers and ports) and the plan first, then the typed word deploy

mega-dashboard-rollback.what: cc-P110: stops the new Homepage, starts the stale one on Haven and this PC's sl-dashboard again. Typed word: roll back

_deploySlots.haven-ops: cc-P107 filled this slot: ops-pages, ops-cutover and ops-rollback above (docker/ops/Deploy-HavenOps.ps1 behind three one-line launchers in D:\UO\haven-migration). The Play tests and Shard status sites carry havenUrl, which the console uses after the cutover.
_deploySlots._notListed: Haven-Wiki-Update.ps1 (updates the DokuWiki container; the wiki is down about a minute) and Haven-Website-Deploy.ps1 (the first-time setup) are deliberately not deploys here.
